- scripts/ai_engine.sh:315-319 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The pool-overlap guard does not check whether the pool overlaps `claude_home`, which is bind-mounted into the model container.
  WHY: A pool configured beneath the Claude session-store directory can pass the guard and expose token files to the model; severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR, and MAJOR is used.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:315-319 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pool-overlap refusal returns 1 without calling `ai_engine_fallback`, so it does not emit the structured fallback log or Telegram notification.
  WHY: Gemini characterizes the missing fallback as breaking the codex fallback contract, while DeepSeek and Minimax note that the refusal is documented not to trigger codex fallback; the missing observability remains.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py:412 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pool isolation test does not exercise an include path that is a symlink resolving into the pool.
  WHY: Without this case, a regression in include-path resolution could go undetected; DeepSeek notes that `realpath -m` follows symlinks, so the concern is test coverage rather than a demonstrated active bypass.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  Expected change site: `scripts/ai_engine.sh` `_ai_engine_pool_isolated` (the guard around lines 194-214 and the call site at line 315), plus a new test in `tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py` next to `test_pool_overlap_guard_rejects_pool_inside_workdir_including_symlink_aliases` (line 412).
  Evidence of absence: `claude_home` (set by `ai_engine_claude_home`, line 160, to `${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/claude-isolated-home`) is bind-mounted into the model container at `scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:526` and is the third host path the read-profile model can read, yet `_ai_engine_pool_isolated` accepts only `pool_dir` and `workdir` plus the `AI_ENGINE_INCLUDE_PATHS` list. The guard at line 315 runs before `claude_home` is computed (line 344-345), and the test at line 412 has no `claude_home` overlap case. The PR's changelog fragment also names only `<workdir>` and `--include` mounts, not `claude_home`. A misconfigured `CLAUDE_ENGINE_POOL_DIR` under the session-store directory would still expose token files to the model.
